job.description:

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
Senior Network Engineer

About the Role
 
We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to provide high-level engineering support across a large university network environment. The role will be responsible for the design, installation, configuration, management and ongoing support of LAN, WAN, wireless, Voice over IP and network security infrastructure.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, support and administer LAN, WAN, wireless and voice network environments.
  • Install, configure and maintain Cisco routers, switches and network hardware.
  • Design and manage network security infrastructure, including firewalls, load balancers and VPNs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation support for complex network problems.
  • Monitor network performance, capacity, utilisation and security.
  • Support enterprise-wide network projects, technology deployments and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Maintain network documentation, including network diagrams and disaster recovery documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, suppliers and stakeholders.
  • Participate in an on-call roster and respond to critical incidents when required.
About You
  • Degree-level qualification in IT, Information Systems or equivalent.
  • Relevant industry certification such as CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent experience.
  • Substantial experience designing and managing large multi-site networks with 5,000+ nodes.
  • Strong experience with Cisco routers, switches and network hardware.
  • Experience with Cisco IOS and NX-OS.
  • Strong enterprise routing and network troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience designing and managing enterprise multi-site wireless networks.
  • Experience with network security, VPNs and firewalls.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Desirable: Experience with Cumulus Linux, PAN-OS, MPLS/VRF Lite, Linux administration, data-center virtualization, software-defined networking, load balancing and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet and Git.

job.title: Product Information & Migration Lead
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Information & Migration Lead to join a major ERP transformation program.

This role will be responsible for preparing a large and complex product catalogue for migration from legacy systems into a new ERP platform. With potentially 100,000+ products/SKUs, you will bring structure and consistency to existing product information and develop the approach for cleansing, mapping, validating and migrating it into the new system.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the product information and master data workstream for the ERP transformation.
  • Review and catalogue existing product and SKU information across legacy systems.
  • Define the future-state product structure, including classifications, attributes and units of measure.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, obsolete or poor-quality data.
  • Develop the Product Information & Migration Plan.
  • Map legacy product data to the new ERP structure.
  • Define data cleansing, transformation and validation requirements.
  • Work with technical teams and implementation partners to deliver the migration.
  • Coordinate data testing, reconciliation, migration rehearsals, cutover and go-live.
  • Facilitate workshops with business SMEs to understand requirements and agree the future-state approach.
  • Establish data quality standards, governance and ownership.
  • Manage migration risks, issues, dependencies and key decisions.
About You You will be an experienced Master Data, Product Information, Data Migration or ERP professional with a strong understanding of complex data environments.

Ideally, you will have:
  • Experience with master data, product information, data migration or ERP transformation.
  • Experience working with large product/SKU catalogues or high-volume datasets.
  • Strong understanding of product hierarchies, classifications, attributes and relationships.
  • Experience with data cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation.
  • Experience developing migration strategies and plans.
  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience working with ERP implementation teams, systems integrators or external vendors.
  • A hands-on and pragmatic approach, with the ability to work through ambiguity and drive outcomes.
Desirable Experience with:
  • Retail, FMCG, manufacturing, distribution or supply chain environments.
  • Large-scale SKU/product migrations.
  • PIM or MDM platforms.
  • SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or other major ERP platforms.
  • Complex ERP transformation programs.

What's on offer?
  • Circa $200k package
  • Initial 24-month FTC
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location.
  • 3-4 days p/w in office.

job.title: Service Desk Lead
job.description:
Service Desk Lead in Perth | Permanent Role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Desk Lead to lead a small team across Australia and help shape the next evolution of the organisation’s technology support function.
This is broader than simply managing a Service Desk. We’re looking for someone who combines strong people leadership and technical credibility with a genuine appetite for innovation. You’ll be responsible for delivering a great end-user experience today, while also looking at how AI, automation and smarter ways of working can improve the service of tomorrow.
The Role You’ll lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 people, creating a high-performing and customer-focused Service Desk that works closely with teams across the broader Technology function.
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Lead, coach and develop the Service Desk team, building capability and creating a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Drive a consistently positive end-user experience, ensuring the Service Desk is seen as a trusted and professional technology partner.
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, supporting the team through more complex issues and escalations.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce AI, automation, self-service and other emerging technologies to improve efficiency and the overall support experience.
  • Maintain strong operational standards across ticket management, prioritisation, escalations and service performance.
  • Build effective relationships across Infrastructure, EUC, Applications, Platforms, Identity and Cyber Security, ensuring issues are resolved collaboratively.
  • Work alongside project teams to understand upcoming technology changes, assess support requirements and help transition new services effectively into BAU.
About You You’ll have experience leading a Service Desk, IT Support or Service Delivery function within an enterprise environment, with a track record of developing people and improving service outcomes.
You’ll bring strong technical knowledge across areas such as Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Identity & Access Management, End User Computing and common enterprise applications. You don't necessarily need to be the person resolving every technical issue yourself, but you should be technically capable enough to lead the team, challenge thinking, understand complex issues and engage credibly with specialist technology teams.
We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about the future of Service Operations.

You’ll naturally look for better ways of doing things and be excited by the opportunity to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve self-service and create a more proactive support model.
You’ll also be a calm and pragmatic leader who communicates well, builds strong stakeholder relationships and is comfortable balancing BAU priorities alongside a busy pipeline of technology change.
The Opportunity This is a chance to take ownership of an established Service Desk while having genuine scope to develop the team, improve the service and introduce new ideas.

For someone who brings together people leadership, technical capability, customer focus and innovation, there’s a real opportunity to make an impact on how Technology support is delivered across the organisation.

job.title: Integration Architect

job.title: Project Manager (Digital)

job.title: IT Manager
job.description:
We are seeking a hands-on and commercially minded IT Manager to take ownership of technology across a growing business. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will play a key role in improving the current technology environment, streamlining business processes and developing a practical technology roadmap to support the organisation's ambitious growth plans.

This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail, solving problems and working closely with the business. You will have the autonomy to identify opportunities, recommend solutions and drive meaningful improvements rather than simply managing external IT providers.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Review the existing systems and applications landscape, identifying opportunities to improve, consolidate and maximise existing technology.
  • Work closely with the business to understand and document workflows, identify inefficiencies and implement technology and automation solutions.
  • Improve the use and effectiveness of Uptick and other business and field service applications.
  • Work directly with field technicians to understand operational challenges and develop practical technology solutions that improve their day-to-day workflows.
  • Manage external IT consultants, vendors and technology partners, ensuring projects are delivered effectively, commercially and in line with business requirements.
  • Improve the quality, accessibility and use of operational and management reporting.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, system integration and improved data utilisation.
  • Provide technology advice to the CEO and owners and contribute to the development and execution of the broader technology roadmap.
  • Ensure the technology environment can scale effectively as the business continues to grow.
About You:
You will be a pragmatic IT professional who is comfortable operating in a small to mid-sized, fast-paced and evolving environment. You don't need a large IT team around you and are equally comfortable developing strategy, managing vendors or getting into the weeds to solve a problem.

You'll ideally have:
  • Experience managing IT within a small or mid-sized business.
  • A proven track record of improving processes through technology, workflow and automation.
  • Strong experience managing external IT consultants, vendors and implementation partners.
  • Experience with field service, workforce management, CRM or operational systems will be highly regarded.
  • A modern approach to technology, with an understanding of cloud applications, integrations, automation and bolt-on solutions.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to prioritise technology investment based on business value.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with both corporate and operational/field-based teams.
  • An entrepreneurial, proactive mindset and the willingness to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
What's on offer?
  • $130k - $150k + Super
  • Permanent Employment
  • Western suburbs of Melbourne location
  • 4 days p/w in office

job.title: HRIS Business Analyst
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior HRIS Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in a large-scale HRIS transformation program. Working alongside an experienced Project Manager, you will be instrumental in shaping the solution from planning and discovery through to implementation, testing and hypercare.
This is an opportunity for a seasoned Business Analyst who has worked across the full lifecycle of HRIS implementations and enjoys operating across business process analysis, requirements, data, integrations and stakeholder engagement.

About the Role:
As a key member of the project team, you will help define the scope of the program, analyse current business processes, assess data quality and integration requirements, and ensure the delivered solution meets business needs. You'll work closely with HR, Technology, Solution Architecture, Engineering, vendors and business stakeholders to deliver a successful enterprise-wide HRIS implementation.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead discovery workshops and requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders.
  • Map end-to-end HR business processes using Level 4 and Level 5 BPMN standards.
  • Capture and document functional, technical, integration and data requirements.
  • Assess existing HR data, identify gaps and develop data remediation recommendations.
  • Analyse system interfaces and work with engineering teams to assess integration complexity.
  • Partner with Solution Architects and delivery teams to support planning, estimation and solution design.
  • Validate vendor solutions against business requirements and identify functional gaps.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability of requirements throughout delivery.
  • Support functional testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover planning and go-live activities.
  • Assist with knowledge transfer and support during hypercare to ensure a smooth transition to business-as-usual.
About You:
You are a confident, hands-on Senior Business Analyst with extensive experience delivering enterprise HR technology projects. You are equally comfortable facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders, analysing complex business processes, and working alongside technical teams to solve integration and data challenges.
You'll bring:
  • 15+ years' experience in Business Analysis, ideally within large enterprise transformation programs.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering end-to-end HRIS implementations or major HR technology projects.
  • Strong experience mapping complex business processes using BPMN (Level 4 & Level 5).
  • Experience analysing system integrations and documenting interface specifications.
  • Proven ability to assess data quality, identify gaps and contribute to data migration and remediation planning.
  • Outstanding workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience working across Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
  • Excellent written documentation and communication skills.
  • Experience using tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, Miro and Excel.
Highly Regarded:
  • Experience delivering enterprise platform or digital transformation programs.
  • Exposure to large-scale system integrations and platform migrations.
  • Previous experience working with leading HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Dayforce or UKG.

What's on offer?
  • Circa $950 p/d
  • 6-month intial contract (extenisons highly likely)
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location (3-4 days p/w in office)

job.title: Draftsperson
job.description:
Our manufacturing client is looking for Draftsperson in Melbourne on contract basis.
Role Purpose:

To prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, models and manufacturing documentation for doors, frames and wall systems.
The role supports production, project delivery and technical teams by converting customer, project and engineering requirements into clear, production-ready drawings, bills of materials and related drafting outputs using SolidWorks, AutoCAD and approved drafting systems.

Responsibilities:
  • Prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, models and manufacturing documentation for doors, frames and wall systems across the assigned portfolio.
  • Use SolidWorks, AutoCAD and approved drafting systems to convert customer, architectural, project and engineering requirements into production-ready outputs.
  • Interpret specifications, drawings and technical information to identify drafting requirements, constraints and information gaps before release to manufacture.
  • Prepare and validate bills of materials, cutting lists and related production documentation based on approved drawings and manufacturing requirements.
  • Apply sound drafting judgement to ensure drawings are accurate, complete, manufacturable and aligned to product, quality and process standards.
  • Prepare accurate drawing outputs and related data to support CNC, press brake and other manufacturing programming requirements.
  • Identify and raise technical, drawing or specification queries with relevant stakeholders, and support resolution before work proceeds.
  • Work with production and quality teams to investigate drawing-related errors, resolve manufacturing issues and reduce repeat defects.
  • Maintain accurate drafting records, drawing revisions and document control in line with business requirements.
  • Provide practical drafting support across multiple business units or product lines, balancing accuracy, production priorities and manufacturing feasibility.
Technical skills & Knowledge:
  • Strong capability in SolidWorks and AutoCAD, with the ability to produce accurate 2D and 3D manufacturing drawings and models.
  • Experience preparing technical drawings for doors, frames, wall systems or similar manufactured building products.
  • Strong ability to interpret architectural drawings, customer specifications, engineering information and manufacturing requirements.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, tolerances, fabrication methods and installation considerations.
  • Ability to prepare and validate bills of materials, cutting lists, drawing revisions and production documentation.
  • Strong spatial awareness and attention to detail, with the ability to identify drawing, specification or manufacturability issues before release to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing drafting priorities and apply sound judgement in a manufacturing environment.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to resolve technical queries with production, project, engineering and quality teams.
If that matches please apply through ad.

job.title: Project Manager

job.title: Transition Manager
job.description:
The Transition Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end transition and migration of business processes, services, capabilities, and functions into the  Capability Centre (CC). The role acts as the primary delivery lead for assigned portfolios and functions, ensuring transitions are executed safely, effectively, and in alignment with strategic, operational, financial, and customer outcomes.
  

The role plays a critical part in enabling Capability Centre strategy, ensuring service continuity, stakeholder confidence, governance compliance, and successful handover of operations into the Capability Centre.
  
  • Transition Strategy & Delivery
    • Lead end-to-end transition delivery for assigned functions, portfolio domains and capabilities transitioning into the Bupa Capability Centre.
    • Drive transition planning through all phases including Discovery, Opportunity Qualification, Recruitment & Planning, Onboarding & Knowledge Transfer, Go-Live & Closure and handover to Post Transition stakeholders.
    • Ensure transitions are delivered to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
    • Support clear transition deliverables, success measures, and exit criteria.  
  • Requirements Gathering & Scoping
    • Facilitate discovery workshops and stakeholder engagement activities to assess transition qualification and suitability.
    • Lead process and capability scope definition, documentation, and validation activities.
    • o Partner with functional SMEs to understand current-state operating models, workloads, dependencies, risks, and controls.
    • Support the definition of future-state operating models and support capability design activities where required.
    • Translate business requirements into actionable transition plans and delivery outcomes.
  
  • Knowledge Transfer and Operational Readiness  
  • Governance, Reporting & Controls
    • Establish transition governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms for assigned functions and capabilities.
    • Provide delivery oversight, ensuring progress is tracked against milestones, schedules, and agreed outcomes.
    • Prepare executive-level status reporting, dashboards, and steering committee materials.
    • Maintain transition plans, RAID registers, decision logs, and governance artefacts with support from PMO resources.
    • Ensure compliance with internal governance, risk, and regulatory requirements.
  
  • Risk, Isssue & Dependency Management
  • Portfolio Planning & Coordination  
  • Continuous Improvement and Capability Building
    • Contribute to the development of transition methodologies, playbooks, templates, and governance frameworks.
    • Capture lessons learned and embed best practices into future transition activities.
    Qualifications, Training and Experience
  
  • Essential
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
    • 8+ years proven experience in some or all the following: process transformation, IT operating model design, transition delivery.
    • Experience managing complex cross-functional projects or portfolios involving multiple stakeholders and business units.
    • Strong transition management, portfolio delivery, and operational readiness experience.
    • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders and executive leaders.
    • Experience managing knowledge transfer, transition, and stabilisation activities within a global delivery environment.
    • Strong risk, issue, dependency, and governance management capabilities.
  
  • Desirable
    •  Experience leading and managing shared services, outsourcing, or Global Capability Centre transitions.
    •  Experience within healthcare, insurance, financial services, or regulated industries.
    •  Knowledge of shared services/capabilities, business process optimisation, or global business services operating models.
    •  Project or Program Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
    •  Change Management certification (Prosci or equivalent).
    •  Lean Six Sigma certification.
  
  If that suits please apply through ad.
